facts.fact: Scott Brinker's first Marketing Technology Landscape Supergraphic in 2011 showed only 150 martech solutions.
facts.quote: only 150 solutions were on the chart.

facts.fact: The 2024 Marketing Technology Landscape Supergraphic listed over 14,106 martech products, a 27.8% year-over-year increase.
facts.quote: there were over [14,106](https://chiefmartec.com/2024/05/2024-marketing-technology-landscape-supergraphic-14106-martech-products-27-8-growth-yoy/) listed in the 2024 edition, reflecting a 27.8% increase from the previous year

facts.fact: US B2B martech spending is expected to reach $10.11 billion USD in 2025, according to an eMarketer forecast cited by StackAdapt.
facts.quote: US B2B martech spending is expected to reach [$10.11 billion USD in 2025]

facts.fact: 60% of respondents to a 2024 survey said they planned to increase or significantly increase their martech investment.
facts.quote: with [60% of respondents to a 2024 survey](https://chart-na1.emarketer.com/268319/change-martech-software-services-investment-among-marketers-europe-north-america-feb-2024-of-respondents) saying they either planned to increase or significantly increase their investment in martech.

facts.fact: 28.8% of US ad agencies said they used six to seven adtech and martech tools in their tech stack, per an April 2024 eMarketer survey.
facts.quote: [28.8%](https://chart-na1.emarketer.com/268056/number-of-different-tools-that-make-up-current-adtechmartech-tech-stack-of-us-ad-agencies-april-2024-of-respondents) of US ad agencies said they used six to seven adtech and martech tools

facts.fact: 17.3% of US ad agencies said they used more than 10 adtech and martech tools in their tech stack.
facts.quote: and 17.3% said they used more than 10.

facts.fact: Adtech includes demand-side platforms (DSPs) that let advertisers buy digital ad inventory programmatically across multiple ad exchanges and supply sources in real time.
facts.quote: Centralized platforms that enable advertisers to buy digital ad inventory programmatically across multiple ad exchanges and supply sources in real time.

facts.fact: Martech primarily leverages 1st-party data collected directly from customer interactions, which is typically stored in CRMs or CDPs.
facts.quote: Martech primarily leverages [1st-party data](https://www.stackadapt.com/resources/blog/1st-party-data) collected directly from customer interactions

facts.fact: A 2023 Forrester study found that disconnect between martech and adtech platforms can result in a 10-13% loss in resources.
facts.quote: A 2023 Forrester study found that this disconnect can result in a [10-13%](https://chart-na1.emarketer.com/263830/percentage-of-waste-martechadtech-platforms-do-not-work-together-seamlessly-according-martech-professionals-worldwide-april-2023) loss in resources.

facts.fact: According to a survey by Ascend2, 60% of marketers say AI and machine learning will have the biggest impact on marketing strategies over the next five years.
facts.quote: According to a survey by Ascend2, [60%](https://content-na1.emarketer.com/marketers-betting-on-ai-innovation-near-future) of marketers say AI and machine learning will have the biggest impact on marketing strategies over the next five years

facts.fact: Martech and adtech are often associated with different stages of the marketing funnel, with adtech primarily focused on customer acquisition and brand awareness and martech driving engagement, conversion, and retention.
facts.quote: adtech primarily focused on customer acquisition and brand awareness and martech driving engagement, conversion, and retention.

facts.fact: Key adtech metrics include impressions and reach (for visibility), and click-through rates, conversions, and cost per acquisition for measuring performance.
facts.quote: Key [adtech metrics](https://www.stackadapt.com/resources/blog/programmatic-kpis-explained) include impressions and reach (for visibility) and click-through rates, conversions, and cost per acquisition

facts.fact: Martech metrics often focus on lead generation and attribution, customer engagement across channels, and retention and lifetime value.
facts.quote: martech metrics often focus on lead generation and attribution, customer engagement across channels, and retention and lifetime value.
